method: per-currency pillar drivers -1/0/+1 from the morning engine reads; positioning scored by the single contrarian rule from the TFF hedge-fund cut (crowded long >=90th = -1, crowded short <=10th = +1, else 0)
note: Monday read, 2026-10-19. Scores: policy = own-bank stance vs counterparty (gap favoring the other side is negative); positioning = contrarian only. China GDP beat 4.5% (AUD +), Kent hawkish (AUD +), French unrest (EUR -), Canada CPI today (CAD settler).
